children.txtContent: =if(@currentField == '', '', if([$FollowUp] != 'Done' && [$FollowUp] != 'None' && Number(@currentField) + 86400000 <= Number(@now), toLocaleDateString(@currentField) + ' · overdue', toLocaleDateString(@currentField)))

attributes.class: =if(@currentField == '', '', if([$FollowUp] != 'Done' && [$FollowUp] != 'None' && Number(@currentField) + 86400000 <= Number(@now), 'sp-field-severity--blocked', if([$FollowUp] != 'Done' && [$FollowUp] != 'None' && Number(@currentField) - Number(@now) <= 604800000, 'sp-field-severity--warning', '')))
